name: Google Sheets
label: Google Sheets API v4 - Read/Write Spreadsheets
description: Read and write Google Sheets via Sheets API v4 using a Google Cloud service-account JWT (RS256 bearer grant; no end-user OAuth). Supports single-range read, batch read, write (overwrite), append rows, clear ranges, and spreadsheet metadata. Auth is the service_account_json key file (PKCS8 private_key + client_email). Official quota is 300 read and 300 write requests/minute per project, plus 60 read and 60 write requests/minute per user per project (a service account counts as one user). Share the spreadsheet with the service account email (Viewer for read/get_metadata; Editor for write/append/clear). The OUTPUT port value is a map of the fields below on success.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Sheets API v4 operation. Required object (delivered as inputVariables.input or currentNode.inputList targetPortValue=input). Choose action, then supply the fields that action needs: range (read/write/append/clear), ranges[] (batch_read), values[][] (write/append). Optional spreadsheet_id overrides the instance config. Optional value_input_option / insert_data_option apply only to write/append. Example: {"action":"read","range":"Sheet1!A1:D10"}.

schema.label: action
schema.description: Which Sheets API v4 call to run. EXACT accepted values (case-sensitive): 'read' (default; GET /{spreadsheetId}/values/{range} with valueRenderOption=FORMATTED_VALUE and dateTimeRenderOption=FORMATTED_STRING), 'batch_read' (GET /{spreadsheetId}/values:batchGet with repeated ranges= query params), 'write' (PUT /{spreadsheetId}/values/{range} overwrite), 'append' (POST /{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}:append), 'clear' (POST /{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}:clear body {}), 'get_metadata' (GET /{spreadsheetId}?fields=spreadsheetId,properties.title,sheets.properties). Any other string raises INVALID_INPUT 'Unknown action: <value>. Use read, batch_read, write, append, clear, or get_metadata.'. Example: 'read'.

schema.label: spreadsheet_id
schema.description: Spreadsheet id for THIS invoke. Overrides configuration spreadsheet_id when non-blank. Purpose: identify the workbook. Extract the path segment from https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/{THIS_PART}/edit. EXACT accepted values: a string of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - only, length >= 20, not containing PLACEHOLDER / YOUR_ / EXAMPLE / TODO (case-insensitive). Typical length ~44. Blank/omitted falls back to config. Invalid values fail with 'Invalid spreadsheet_id: …'. Example: '1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms'.

schema.label: range
schema.description: A1 notation range for read, write, append, and clear. Ignored by batch_read (use ranges) and get_metadata. Purpose: select cells. EXACT accepted values: Google A1 strings such as 'Sheet1!A1:D10', 'Sheet1!A:D', 'Keywords_Market!A2:D100', or a named range. The handler path-encodes the range (quote safe='') so Sheet1!A1:D10 becomes Sheet1%21A1%3AD10. Required for read/write/append/clear; missing read → "range is required for read action (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:D10').". Example: 'Sheet1!A1:D10'.

schema.label: ranges
schema.description: List of A1 notation ranges for batch_read only. Purpose: fetch several ranges in one HTTP call. EXACT accepted values: a JSON array of strings (must be a list; a comma-separated string is rejected). Each element is one A1 range like range. Required for batch_read; missing/non-list/empty → 'ranges (list of A1 notation strings) is required for batch_read.'. Ignored for other actions. Example: ['Sheet1!A:D', 'Sheet2!A1:B20', 'Summary!A1'].

schema.label: values
schema.description: 2D array of cell values for write and append. Purpose: the rows to store. EXACT accepted values: a JSON array of rows, each row a JSON array of cells (string, number, boolean, or empty). Empty list / omitted is treated as missing. Required together with range for write ('range and values (2D array) are required for write action.') and append (same wording with 'append'). Ignored for read/batch_read/clear/get_metadata. Example: [['Name','Score'],['Ada',98],['Bob',71]].

schema.label: value_input_option
schema.description: How Google interprets write/append cell input (Sheets valueInputOption). EXACT accepted values: 'USER_ENTERED' (default; formulas like =SUM(A1:A2), dates, and numbers are parsed as if typed in the UI) or 'RAW' (store the literal string/number with no parsing). Blank/omitted → USER_ENTERED. Ignored for read/batch_read/clear/get_metadata. Other strings are forwarded to the API and typically yield HTTP 400. Example: 'USER_ENTERED'.

schema.label: insert_data_option
schema.description: Where append places new rows (Sheets insertDataOption). EXACT accepted values: 'INSERT_ROWS' (default; insert new rows for the data) or 'OVERWRITE' (write into the existing grid starting at the range, overwriting cells). Blank/omitted → INSERT_ROWS. Used only for action='append'. Other strings are forwarded to the API and typically yield HTTP 400. Example: 'INSERT_ROWS'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Operation result map. Success objects always include status='ok' plus action-specific fields below. Secrets (private_key, JWT, access_token, raw key JSON) are redacted to ***. Example success: {"status":"ok","read_range":"Sheet1!A1:D10","major_dimension":"ROWS","cell_data":[["A"]],"rows_returned":1}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on success. EXACT accepted value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Read Range
schema.description: A1 range Google actually returned for action='read' (may expand Sheet1!A:D to Sheet1!A1:D100). Purpose: confirm which cells were read. Example: 'Sheet1!A1:D10'. Absent for other actions.

schema.label: Major Dimension
schema.description: Orientation of cell_data for action='read'. EXACT values from the API: 'ROWS' (default when omitted) or 'COLUMNS'. This node always requests majorDimension ROWS on write/append. Example: 'ROWS'.

schema.label: Cell Data
schema.description: 2D array of formatted cell values for action='read' (valueRenderOption=FORMATTED_VALUE, dates as FORMATTED_STRING). Empty array [] when the range has no values. Each inner array is one row. Example: [['Name','Score'],['Ada','98']]. Absent for other actions.

schema.label: Rows Returned
schema.description: Count of rows in cell_data for action='read' (len(values), integer >= 0). Example: 12. Absent for other actions (batch_read uses per-range rows_returned inside value_ranges).

schema.label: Ranges Returned
schema.description: Number of entries in value_ranges for action='batch_read' (integer >= 0). Example: 2. Absent for other actions.

schema.label: Value Ranges
schema.description: Array of per-range objects for action='batch_read'. Each object: range (string A1), values (2D array, [] if empty), rows_returned (number). Example: [{"range":"Sheet1!A1:B2","values":[["a","b"]],"rows_returned":1}]. Absent for other actions.

schema.label: Updated Range
schema.description: A1 range Google reports as written for action='write' (updatedRange) or action='append' (updates.updatedRange). Empty string if the API omitted it. Example: 'Sheet1!A1:B3'. Absent for read/clear/get_metadata.

schema.label: Updated Rows
schema.description: Row count reported updated for action='write' (updatedRows) or action='append' (updates.updatedRows). Default 0 when omitted. Example: 3.

schema.label: Updated Columns
schema.description: Column count reported updated for action='write' only (updatedColumns). Default 0 when omitted. Absent for append (python does not surface it). Example: 4.

schema.label: Updated Cells
schema.description: Cell count reported updated for action='write' (updatedCells) or action='append' (updates.updatedCells). Default 0 when omitted. Example: 12.

schema.label: Cleared Range
schema.description: A1 range Google reports as cleared for action='clear' (clearedRange, falling back to the requested range). Example: 'Sheet1!A1:D10'. Absent for other actions.

schema.label: Title
schema.description: Workbook title for action='get_metadata' (properties.title). Empty string when omitted. Example: 'Q3 Market Keywords'. Absent for other actions.

schema.label: Sheets Count
schema.description: Number of worksheets in the workbook for action='get_metadata' (len(sheets)). Integer >= 0. Example: 3.

schema.label: Sheets
schema.description: Worksheet list for action='get_metadata'. Each object: sheet_id (number, Sheets sheetId), title (string), index (number, 0-based tab order), row_count (number from gridProperties.rowCount), column_count (number from gridProperties.columnCount). Example: [{"sheet_id":0,"title":"Sheet1","index":0,"row_count":1000,"column_count":26}].

configurationParameters.label: Service Account JSON
configurationParameters.description:
Google Cloud service-account key (Required). Purpose: mint a per-request OAuth access token via JWT RS256 (iss=client_email, scope=https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets, aud=https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token). EXACT accepted values: the full downloaded key JSON as a string, or that object already parsed. Required fields used by the handler: client_email, private_key (PEM PKCS8, -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----). Other usual fields (type=service_account, project_id, private_key_id, client_id, token_uri, auth_uri, auth_provider_x509_cert_url, client_x509_cert_url, universe_domain) are accepted and ignored except as documentation. Setup: console.cloud.google.com → create/select project → enable Google Sheets API → IAM → Service accounts → Keys → Add JSON key. Then share the sheet with client_email. Never log this value. Example (truncated): {"type":"service_account","project_id":"my-proj","private_key":"-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
...
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----
","client_email":"sheets@my-proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com","token_uri":"https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"}.

configurationParameters.label: Default Spreadsheet ID
configurationParameters.description: Default workbook id when input.spreadsheet_id is blank. Purpose: pin an instance to one spreadsheet. EXACT accepted values: same rules as input.spreadsheet_id (A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -, length >= 20, no PLACEHOLDER/YOUR_/EXAMPLE/TODO). Optional. Get it from docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/{THIS_PART}/edit. Input overrides this per request. Example: '1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms'.

configurationParameters.label: Action
configurationParameters.description: Sheets call. EXACT: read, batch_read, write, append, clear, get_metadata.

configurationParameters.label: Range
configurationParameters.description: A1 range for read, write, append, and clear. Example: Sheet1!A1:D10. INPUT wins.

configurationParameters.label: Ranges
configurationParameters.description: JSON array of A1 ranges for batch_read. INPUT wins.

configurationParameters.label: Values
configurationParameters.description: 2D JSON array for write and append. Example: [["Name","Score"],["Ada",98]]. INPUT wins.

configurationParameters.label: Value input option
configurationParameters.description: write/append. USER_ENTERED or RAW. Empty uses USER_ENTERED.

configurationParameters.label: Insert data option
configurationParameters.description: append only. INSERT_ROWS or OVERWRITE. Empty uses INSERT_ROWS.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-HTTP connect+read timeout for the token POST and every Sheets call. Purpose: bound hung Google APIs. EXACT accepted values: positive integers. Missing, blank, 0, or negative fall back to 25. Does not cache tokens — each invoke also spends this budget on oauth2.googleapis.com/token. Example: 25. Keep at or below the sandbox request budget.
